northStar: Evidence-driven, application-aware authorized security assessment: application model -> grounded hypotheses -> bounded approved proof -> retained evidence -> safe recovery -> regression verification
roadmapPhases: M1 full local assessment vertical slice and UX
M4 role and business logic differential proof
nonNegotiables: no automatic replay of ambiguous mutations
no external scanning without owner consent
nextAfterCurrent: Extend reviewed function/role authorization and business-flow differential evidence into a complete guided proof and pinned regression experience on owned fixtures. Reuse existing graph/IR/workbench/recovery; expand sealed fixtures and operator explanations. Preserve all 20 master roadmap items and HOLDs. Do not repeat proven worker/recovery engineering without a new source-backed defect.
codexDelivery: one verified comprehensive ZIP only; complete sources, increment+cumulative patches, RED/GREEN receipts, hash/owner verifier, decision and continuity
externalEvidenceNotBundled: Live owner working tree and installed dependencies are not a portable release; all current changed source and transitive inspection context are in the packet
Prior archives are referenced by authenticated hashes; current increment raw evidence and prior source/preservation bindings are bundled

newCapabilities.hypotheses: Bounded deterministic ranked/deduped questions from exact native map/IR/typed-marker controls, with counterevidence and ABSTAIN; not findings or inferred policy
newCapabilities.review: Append-only org-scoped proposal and one-time human decision records, explicit supersession, existing reviewed workbench matrix and separate bounded native proof
newCapabilities.custody: Refuse duplicate/missing native check IDs even when a fault fixture updates registry hash; immutable map and current authority rechecked at admission
newCapabilities.applications: Native Windows document and numeric-record synthetic applications, legitimate shared policy controls, reviewed vulnerability/remediation comparisons, integrated Edge journey
limitations: No calibrated likelihood/impact model, AI, broad vulnerability engine or ownership inference
Both purpose-built applications use node:http and existing source-mode runtime
Selected one-route PASS is not full application acceptance; no installed release, field, provider or Linux verification
Source evidence must be fresh and complete; append-only missing matrix acknowledgements stay visible and cannot be automatically replayed
